answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 35806 Country: India Title: Is it prohibited or is unlikely to Rasool for making bending noise of fingers (ungliyon ko todna) Question: Is it prohibited or is unlikely to Rasool for making bending noise of fingers (ungliyon ko todna)? I used to do it during much time of the day even when I used to be in Masjid, especially when I am thinking something? Is it alright? Answer ID: 35806 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 81/81/M=1433) During salah this practice is makrooh and against Sunnah, while it is undesirable out of salah. It is worst in mosque than out of the mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
